scope: Protocol, independence, sealing, and scoring rules only. This file contains no probes, answers, research-case selections, or evaluation results.

prior_exposure.consequence: The operator may specify protocol and metrics but must never author, edit, suggest, preview, or approve holdout probes or ground truth.

holdout_composition.authoring_rule: The independent author creates the actual packages and ground truth without operator assistance. Category names are design strata, not probe instructions.

independence_requirements.eligible_author: A human or separate agent with no access to detector source code, detector rules, Benchmark V2 probe contents, or detector-development discussions.
required_attestation: No detector source, rules, prompts, or implementation were accessed.
No Benchmark V2 probe content or expected outputs were accessed.
No probe content was supplied, edited, or suggested by the operator.
No detector output was observed before the probe archive and ground truth were sealed.
disqualifiers: Any access to detector implementation or rule logic.
Any access to disclosed Benchmark V2 probes.
Any tuning or revision after detector outputs are observed.
Any operator authorship or substantive editing of probes or ground truth.

before_scoring: Independent author finalizes an opaque probe archive and a separate ground-truth archive.
Compute SHA-256 for both archives and every contained file.
Create a manifest containing filenames, byte sizes, hashes, category counts, author attestation, and creation timestamp.
Commit only the manifest and encrypted or access-controlled sealed artifacts before the operator receives test-time access.
Claude reviews the manifest, attestation, counts, and hashes before authorizing the single scoring run.
test_time_sequence: Release the frozen probe archive to the operator only at test time.
Run the frozen detector once and immediately hash and commit the raw detector outputs.
Release ground truth only after raw detector outputs are committed.
Run the frozen scorer once and commit the complete score record.
prohibited: Changing probes, labels, detector rules, thresholds, or metrics after any output is observed.
Repeated scoring to select a preferred result.

scoring.primary_endpoint: binary detection of whether a package contains at least one planted error
scoring.uncertainty: Report Wilson 95% confidence intervals for all binomial proportions.
scoring.zero_division: Return null and disclose the undefined metric; never substitute a perfect score.
scoring.missing_or_unreadable_package: Count as a scored failure and report separately; do not silently exclude.
scoring.decision_rule: All four primary thresholds must be met in the single authoritative run. Category-level results and confidence intervals remain visible even when the aggregate rule is met.

single_run_rule.technical_abort_rule: A run may be classified as a technical abort only if no detector output or score was emitted. Any replacement attempt requires explicit Claude and human authorization and must preserve the abort evidence.
single_run_rule.result_policy: Report the observed result without rerunning, tuning, deleting, or substituting probes.

activation_conditions: Probe and ground-truth artifacts are hashed and frozen.
